# Clear Glass recipe unlock fixtures

Forty-nine unchanged generated advancement JSON files from Tinkers’ Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`. Hashes are in `sha256.json`.
Sources are under `src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes/`:

- `building_blocks/common/glass/{color}_clear_stained_glass.json` (16 colors)
- `decorations/common/glass/{color}_clear_stained_glass_pane.json` (16 colors)
- `decorations/common/glass/{color}_clear_stained_glass_pane_from_panes.json` (16 colors)
- `decorations/common/glass/clear_glass_pane.json`

Native copies use existing flattened recipe IDs and the host's `recipes`
predicate key. Inventory criteria and OR requirements remain unchanged.

Source: https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2
License: `tconstruct/third_party/tconstruct/LICENSE`.
